summary: A safety recommendation changes what a mechanic may put back into service.
realLife: After the transportation board investigated the Mutiny Bay seaplane crash, De Havilland Canada revised the maintenance manual so mechanics replace a lock ring each time they take the assembly apart.
gates: The manufacturer has issued the revised maintenance instructions.
inGame: needs: an operator's maintenance rule and adoption date linked to a safety recommendation.

turns.what: One operator adopts the replacement rule across its own fleet.
turns.pulledBy: Its shop can obtain replacements before the manufacturer revises the manual.
turns.writesBack: The operator's work orders change first.

turns.what: A shop takes an assembly out of service while it waits for the replacement.
turns.pulledBy: The revised manual applies and no replacement is in stock.
turns.writesBack: The maintenance log records the equipment idle.
